name: Eldridge Industries (as purchaser of publishing rights)

podcast.title: Investment in Music Catalogs
podcast.body: Eldridge Industries is a diversified company that invests in music, alongside insurance and real estate. They purchased the publishing rights to The Killers' entire back catalog prior to 2020. "Eldridge Industries and they invested everything from insurance to real estate to music."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: The Killers Catalog Acquisition
podcast.body: Eldridge Industries is the company that acquired the entire creative output of The Killers released prior to 2020. While the exact financial terms were not public, the deal was estimated to be between $100 million and $150 million, reflecting The Killers' enduring popularity.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Concept of Selling Out: Part 2
